source_pattern_name_zh: 图像驱动的跨学科专家识别/匹配
activation_signals: has_image=True and the problem text directly references the image ("the attached image", "plot 3").
Answer form is a panel-index string, a scientific name, coordinate values, or a multi-parameter tuple.
The problem provides a candidate parameter list or candidate-object list and asks you to match it against the image.
problem_signatures: 题目显式依赖图片：多子图、曲线对比、显微/摄影、凝胶/谱图、Google Trends、广告图。
答案经常是：按子图编号排序串 (e.g. DDdd0zZZccCCBbbB)、物种学名、参数元组、数值。
错误往往不在于知识缺失，而在于没有把图片里的每一个标注/刻度/图例系统读出来。
likely_failure_modes: Reading only the primary visual while ignoring legend, color mapping, sub-panel indices, and text labels.
Turning a multi-panel matching task into a guess instead of quantitatively comparing each panel's features against the candidate table.
Ignoring auxiliary clues provided in the problem text (genome length, units, time window) and relying on the figure caption alone.

sop_phases.title: Phase 1 — Exhaustive Image Inventory
steps: Build one record per sub-panel: {index, axis ranges, units, legend / color mapping, text labels, recognizable feature points}.
Do not skip the legend or small-print caption — it is often the decisive clue.
In multi-panel tasks, always follow the panel ordering given by the problem.

sop_phases.title: Phase 2 — Feature ↔ Hypothesis Matching
steps: Arrange the candidate parameters / scientific names / events as comparable feature vectors.
For string-matching answers ("sort the panels as a character string"), nail down which character position maps to which panel.
For identification tasks, first narrow to the broad class (phylum / family / genre / era), then refine down to species / specific work.

sop_phases.title: Phase 3 — Unused-Label Self-Audit
steps: Ask: is there any prominent label in the image I have NOT used? If so it is likely the key clue to the answer.
For every panel, require two independent visual features to agree before concluding.
If two candidates both match a single panel, refine the feature; if they are still indistinguishable, return to Phase 1 and re-read the image.

sop_phases.title: Phase 4 — Output Formatting
steps: For index-string answers, produce one character per panel in the order specified by the problem; no separator unless requested.
Scientific names follow Genus species: genus capitalized, epithet lower-case.
Numeric answers carry units only if the problem specifies them.

subtype_playbook: **Multi-panel physical simulations (wave / heat / fluid)**: use steady-state value, symmetry, and first zero-crossing as robust features.
**RT-PCR / Western-blot gels**: count bands, align molecular-weight ladder, match each lane to its sample label.
**Biological species identification**: combine body features (wing spots, abdominal segments, eyespots) with geographic / plant cues in the image.
**Historical / art images**: conjoin costume, composition, symbolism, and background text as a multi-constraint match.
**Google Trends**: inspect peak time and relative height and map the event sequence to candidate events.
**Geometric identification (Goldberg polyhedra etc.)**: count faces, vertices, edges first, then apply the classification formula.
output_rules: String answers follow the exact case and separator shown in the problem.
Scientific names follow binomial nomenclature; numerical precision mirrors the problem's example.
